coords.description: The coordinates of the system. Only present when  {@link  SystemRequestOptions#showCoordinates  }  option is set to 1.

coordsLocked.description: True when exact coords are known. False when position is trilaterated. Only present when  {@link  SystemRequestOptions#showCoordinates  }  option is set to 1

duplicates.description: The systems ID having the exact same name in the game. Only present when there are duplicated and  {@link  SystemRequestOptions#showId  }  option is set to 1.

hidden_at.description: The time when the system was hidden. Only present when system is hidden and  {@link  SystemRequestOptions#includeHidden  }  is set to 1

id.description: The EDSM ID of the system. Only present when  {@link  SystemRequestOptions#showId  }  option is set to 1.

id64.description: The Frontier ID of the system. Only present when  {@link  SystemRequestOptions#showId  }  option is set to 1.

information.description: System information. Only present when  {@link  SystemRequestOptions#showInformation  }  option is set to 1.

mergedTo.description: The system ID this system was merged to. Only present when system was merged and,   {@link  SystemRequestOptions#includeHidden  }  is set to 1 and  {@link  SystemRequestOptions#showId  }  is also set to 1.

permitName.description: Permit name if any. Only present when  {@link  SystemRequestOptions#showPermit  }  option is set to 1.

primaryStar.description: Information about the primary star if any. Only present when  {@link  SystemRequestOptions#showPrimaryStar  }  option is set to 1.

requirePermit.description: Permit information. Only present when  {@link  SystemRequestOptions#showPermit  }  option is set to 1.
